title: Canonical integral scalar action on completed-coefficient complexes
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with ring of integers $R=\mathcal O_E$ and chosen uniformizer $\varpi$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $T$ be a scheme and use its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Write $B_T=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(R/\varpi^n)_T$ for the completed constant coefficient ring sheaf with its actual quotient projections $q_n$ and canonical constant-to-completed map [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Put $\mathcal A=\operatorname{Mod}(B_T)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and let $Q:\mathrm{CoCh}(\mathcal A)\to D(\mathcal A)$ be localization at quasi-isomorphisms [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For $a\in R$ and a site object $U$, let $c_a(U)\in B_T(U)$ be the image of the constant section $a$ under the canonical constant-to-completed map, equivalently the unique section whose $q_n$-image is the constant section $a\bmod\varpi^n$ for every $n\geq1$. Define the natural chain endomorphism $\sigma_a$ of the identity on $\mathrm{CoCh}(\mathcal A)$ by $(\sigma_a(P)^i)_U(x)=c_a(U)x$. Define its derived action $\overline\sigma_a$ to be the unique natural endomorphism of the identity on $D(\mathcal A)$ whose whiskering along $Q$ is $Q(\sigma_a)$, obtained through the fully faithful whiskering functor of localization.
